_comment: Greedy continuation of the built-in self-test prompt, checked by hand against the int8 model on the board. qwen35-serve.py --selftest compares its own tokens against this list and prints 'quality: pass' or 'quality: MISMATCH' (a mismatch does not stop the service, it means the model or the tokenizer changed and the text should be looked at again).
